reason: `context.debugger` pauses the next action or a `page.pause()`, reports the paused action's details, resumes, and runs to a location. DB-007 and DB-010 check that pause (`requestPause`, `resume`, `pausedDetails`) skips internal calls and keeps working beside the api-call stream. Strider has no debugger or breakpoint API (the `method-debugger-*` rows and `property-browsercontext-debugger`), so these can't be ported

Playwright's internal debugger traffic: `_enable` streams the API calls its own dashboard shows, with the error status, the action point and the source location of calls, and `_wrapApiCall({ internal })` marks calls its dashboard makes so they're left out. Strider has no such stream or internal-call marker. DB-008 and DB-009 also pause an action to set up their state, which is the feature gap of DB-001 to DB-003
